items.title: Government Notifies Navi Mumbai Airport as a Port for Import of Drugs under the Drugs Rules, 1945
items.snippet: Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau Ministry of Health and Family Welfare Government Notifies Navi Mumbai Airport as a Port for Import of Drugs under the Drugs Rules, 1945 Amendment to Rule 43A to Facilitate Import of Drugs through Navi Mumbai Airport Total Number of Notified Ports of Entry for Import of Drugs Reaches 42, Strengthening Pharmaceutical Logistics and Trade Facilitation प्रविष्टि तिथि: 08 JUL 2…
